title: Cross-Surface Identity and Authorization Model v1

identities.name: Local User
identities.credential_source: Operating system user session (UID/GID, macOS LocalAuthentication framework)
identities.authentication_method: macOS LocalAuthentication framework (Touch ID, Apple Watch, system password); falls back to OS-level user verification via pyobjc-framework-LocalAuthentication
identities.authorization_scope: Full local operator access: launch cockpit, ACP server, all tools. Can approve mutations, manage providers, configure fleet orchestration.
identities.approval_requirements: Local user must interactively approve mutation tool calls through the cockpit approval gate. No remote approval path.
identities.token_key_storage: macOS Keychain via keyring library; OAuth tokens in ~/.rig/relay/.env
identities.revocation_story: Token revocation via provider dashboards; local session revocation via cockpit logout or process termination
identities.rotation_story: Onboarding wizard prompts key rotation on expiry; manual rotation via /provider slash command
identities.telemetry_redaction: User identity reduced to SHA256 hash; no raw usernames or UIDs in telemetry

identities.name: Workspace Operator
identities.credential_source: Workspace-level config (~/.rig/relay/config.toml operator section) plus local user identity
identities.authentication_method: Derived from local_user authentication; workspace role assignment verified against config TOML
identities.authorization_scope: Operator-level workspace management: configure tools, manage agents, approve merge/preproduction gates, view fleet status. Cannot mutate identity or auth configuration.
identities.approval_requirements: Merge approval requires both workspace operator approval and SHA match verification. Preproduction approval is separate.
identities.token_key_storage: Inherits local_user keychain storage; no separate credential material
identities.revocation_story: Role removal via config TOML edit; effective on next config reload
identities.rotation_story: No token rotation; role reassignment via config
identities.telemetry_redaction: Operator role captured as enum; no raw config values in telemetry

identities.name: Agent Identity
identities.credential_source: Agent profile (default, orchestrator, plan, explorer, builder, cleaner, bug-exterminator) mapped to session-scoped identity
identities.authentication_method: Session-scoped agent identity derived from agent profile selection at session start. No persistent credential — identity lives for session duration.
identities.authorization_scope: Tool permissions defined by agent profile (ALWAYS / ASK / NEVER per tool). Can invoke LLM backends with provider credentials inherited from local_user. Can read workspace files, produce reports, create checkpoints.
identities.approval_requirements: ASK-permission tools require interactive approval from local_user through cockpit. Mutation tools require patch gating approval.
identities.token_key_storage: No persistent storage. Session-scoped. Provider API keys inherited from local_user keychain.
identities.revocation_story: Session termination (cockpit logout, process kill, or session reset) revokes agent identity
identities.rotation_story: Not applicable — agent identity is session-scoped
identities.telemetry_redaction: Agent profile name captured as enum; session ID hashed; no provider API keys in telemetry

identities.name: Subagent Identity
identities.credential_source: Parent agent identity plus subagent profile (explorer, builder, cleaner, bug-exterminator)
identities.authentication_method: Scoped subagent spawned from parent agent session. Inherits parent session context but with narrower tool set and isolated worktree scope.
identities.authorization_scope: Tool set restricted by subagent profile (e.g., builder has write_file + search_replace + task; explorer has grep + read_file only). Worktree-scoped — cannot access parent workspace directly.
identities.approval_requirements: Subagent mutations require patch gating within the isolated worktree. Adoption merge from subagent worktree requires parent agent + workspace operator approval.
identities.token_key_storage: No persistent storage. Inherits parent agent's provider key chain.
identities.revocation_story: Parent session termination cascades to subagent sessions; subagent worktree is isolated and can be discarded
identities.rotation_story: Not applicable — subagent identity is session-scoped
identities.telemetry_redaction: Subagent profile + parent session hash in telemetry; no raw subagent worktree paths

identities.name: MCP Client Identity
identities.credential_source: MCP client host (Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed) configured in ~/.rig/relay/mcp_clients.toml or runtime registration
identities.authentication_method: Token-gated MCP server connection. Client presents a registration token. Tiered permission model (read-only → analysis → validation → patch proposal → mutation) enforced per client.
identities.authorization_scope: Tiered: read-only clients can only use read tools; mutation-tier clients can use all tools but each mutation call requires a separate grant. Cannot access identity or auth configuration.
identities.approval_requirements: Mutation-tier MCP clients require explicit mutation grant per tool invocation. No interactive approval — governance is declarative (tier assignment in config).
identities.token_key_storage: MCP client tokens stored in ~/.rig/relay/mcp_client_tokens.json (append-only, token-hashed)
identities.revocation_story: Token revocation via mcp_client_tokens.json entry removal or tier downgrade; effective on next MCP connection
identities.rotation_story: Token rotation via re-registration; old token invalidated on new token issuance
identities.telemetry_redaction: MCP client identity reduced to SHA256 hash; tier captured as enum; no raw tokens in telemetry

identities.name: ACP Peer Identity
identities.credential_source: ACP peer agent registered via ACP server handshake. Peer identity derived from editor integration (Zed, JetBrains, VS Code).
identities.authentication_method: ACP handshake with session token. Editor-side capability broker validates against the canonical capability manifest before sending requests.
identities.authorization_scope: Editor-scoped: can request context, propose edits, stream progress. Edit proposals are gated by permission model. Cannot bypass cockpit approval for mutations.
identities.approval_requirements: Edit proposals require permission gating. If cockpit is running, interactive approval may be required for certain tools.
identities.token_key_storage: ACP session tokens stored in memory during session; no persistent storage
identities.revocation_story: ACP session termination (editor disconnect, ACP server shutdown)
identities.rotation_story: Per-session token generation; no rotation needed
identities.telemetry_redaction: ACP peer identity hashed; editor type captured as enum; no raw session tokens

identities.name: A2A Remote Agent Identity
identities.credential_source: A2A agent card (declared capabilities, mission scope) plus remote agent authentication token
identities.authentication_method: A2A handshake with agent card verification. Remote agent presents its agent card; orchestrator validates capabilities and issues task dispatch.
identities.authorization_scope: Task-scoped: can only execute dispatched tasks within declared capability boundary. File access restricted to assigned worktree. Cannot mutate orchestrator workspace.
identities.approval_requirements: Task dispatch requires orchestrator approval. Results require adoption approval before merge.
identities.revocation_story: Token revocation via a2a_agent_tokens.json; effective on next A2A handshake
identities.rotation_story: Token rotation via re-registration with new agent card
identities.telemetry_redaction: Remote agent identity hashed; agent card capabilities captured as enum list; no raw tokens

identities.name: SSH Host Identity
identities.credential_source: SSH host key + host identity certificate registered in ~/.rig/relay/ssh_hosts.json
identities.authentication_method: SSH host key verification. Host presents its key; supervisor validates against registered host entries before allowing command execution.
identities.authorization_scope: Host-scoped: can execute commands within the assigned host boundary. Commands must pass through the supervisor's subprocess governance (environment scrubbing, binary rejection, symlink protection). Cannot access other hosts or the local workspace.
identities.approval_requirements: Command execution requires supervisor preflight. No interactive approval path — governance is declarative.
identities.revocation_story: Host key removal from ssh_hosts.json; effective on next connection attempt
identities.rotation_story: Host key rotation via re-registration with new host key
identities.telemetry_redaction: SSH host identity hashed; command SHA256 captured; no raw host keys or command text

identities.name: Hosted Tenant User Admin
identities.credential_source: Tenant admin credentials stored in tenant registry (~/.rig/relay/tenants/). Authenticated via hosted API with tenant-scoped RBAC.
identities.authentication_method: Tenant API key + tenant ID verification. RBAC roles (admin, operator, viewer) enforced at API boundary. Multi-tenant isolation via TenantRegistry.
identities.authorization_scope: Tenant-scoped: can manage agents, tools, fleet within tenant boundary. Cannot cross tenant boundaries. Cannot access local user files or other tenant data.
identities.approval_requirements: Tenant admin actions are self-approved within tenant scope. Cross-tenant operations require explicit tenant federation approval.
identities.token_key_storage: Tenant API keys in ~/.rig/relay/tenants/<tenant_id>/credentials.json (encrypted at rest)
identities.revocation_story: Tenant API key rotation via hosted API admin endpoint; tenant deletion via TenantRegistry
identities.rotation_story: API key rotation with configurable rotation period; old key invalidated after grace period
identities.telemetry_redaction: Tenant ID hashed; RBAC role captured as enum; no raw API keys

identities.name: GitHub App Installation Identity
identities.credential_source: GitHub App installation token managed by GitHub App token manager (_github_app_token_manager.py)
identities.authentication_method: GitHub App installation token (short-lived, auto-refreshed). Token manager requests new installation tokens via GitHub API using the app's private key.
identities.authorization_scope: Installation-scoped: can read/write to repositories where the GitHub App is installed. Code scanning, PR mutation, profile README updates. Subject to GitHub provider governance (carte blanche governed lanes).
identities.approval_requirements: PR mutation requires code scanning preflight + mutation readiness gate. Carte blanche governed lanes provide scoped autonomous execution.
identities.token_key_storage: GitHub App private key in ~/.rig/relay/github_app/private_key.pem; installation tokens in memory only
identities.revocation_story: GitHub App uninstallation from repository; token manager ceases token refresh
identities.rotation_story: GitHub App private key rotation via GitHub App settings; installation tokens auto-rotate (1 hour TTL)
identities.telemetry_redaction: Installation ID hashed; repository name hashed; no raw installation tokens or private keys

identities.name: Service Account Identity
identities.credential_source: Service account credentials in ~/.rig/relay/service_accounts/<sa_id>/credentials.json (encrypted at rest). Backed by 5-backend secrets resolution.
identities.authentication_method: Service account token with backend-specific credential resolution (keyring, env var, file, remote vault, hardware token). Attestation signing via HMAC-SHA256.
identities.authorization_scope: Attestation-scoped: can sign attestations for pipeline integrations (CI/CD, artifact signing, release gate). Cannot interact with the cockpit or agent loop directly. Read-only access to evidence ledger.
identities.approval_requirements: Attestation signing requires service account credential validation + policy decision from the live mutation readiness gate.
identities.token_key_storage: Encrypted credentials in ~/.rig/relay/service_accounts/<sa_id>/credentials.json; backend resolution chain cached in memory
identities.revocation_story: Service account deletion via admin CLI; credential file removal invalidates all pending attestations
identities.rotation_story: Credential rotation via admin CLI with configurable rotation policy; 5-backend resolution chain re-evaluates on rotation
identities.telemetry_redaction: Service account ID hashed; attestation hash captured; no raw credentials
